{{Top|leg}}
A '''guild council''' was an organization withing [[Gree (species)/Legends|Gree]] society. The council's members were made up of [[Master (Gree)|masters]] and usually there were a limited number of seats. A Gree could only move up from [[senior assistant]] to master if there was an available seat on the guild council. Seats could be added if the assistant was noted as a profound expert within the field.<ref name="The Gree Enclave">{{JournalCite|8|The Gree Enclave}}</ref>
